scope: Open3D boundary-topology and statistical-outlier evidence only; no CLI, SDK, workflow, image, or robotics capability is delivered.

disposition.why: The retained values were produced from unidentified input bytes by a boundary walker that did not prove closed edge-exact loops on non-vertex-manifold meshes. The source bundle was lost, so regeneration is impossible.
disposition.documented_tradeoff: The existing support-crop record already states that cropping trades invented coverage for honest holes. This record does not claim that trade was previously hidden.

replacement_method.publication_policy: A future result may publish only with passing closed/two-loop/bowtie/open-fragment controls and SHA-256 identities for the cloud and both meshes.
replacement_method.outcome_semantics: Boundary topology and descriptive distances only. Interior-hole classification, hole surface area, and fitted/rejected causality remain unestablished.
